pr_body:
# Fixed Router renders component twice

Fixes #47058

issue_context.title: [Blazor] Router seems to be rendering twice
issue_context.body:
From what I can tell, when there is no handler passed to the router, it will render the component twice:
https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/main/src/Components/Components/src/Routing/Router.cs#L256-L259

Probably there should be an early return after the highlighted `Refresh`

review_comments: Could you write a test for it?
We want to have a test that ensures we only render once. It's likely possible to author one as a unit test, rather than splurge for an E2E test.

If we notice something in code like this, and we didn't catch it before, it means that there is a gap in our testing, so we want to 1) put a test in place to ensure the right behavior (before and after) and 2) prevent the behavior from regressing in the future

Sorry I removed my previous comment. I just checked unit tests and agreed that we need a test for that and removed my question. and you were already typing the reply. 

Thanks!
